verdict.rationale: Postmark's own docs list a first-party inbound capability: configuring an inbound server, inbound domain forwarding, parsing an email, a sample inbound workflow, and retrying failed inbound messages for processing. The evidence is limited to section headings, so the MX setup steps, the parsed payload contents and webhook delivery of inbound messages are implied rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MX record configuration, the parsed payload fields (headers, body, attachments), confirmation that parsed messages are POSTed to a user webhook, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive email — point MX records at the service and get parsed messages (headers, body, attachments) delivered to my webhook or API

citations.quote: Inbound domain forwarding \- Parse an email \- Configure inbound blocking \- Sample inbound workflow
Retry a failed inbound message for processing
